report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces returned HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No bounded cause is substantiated; hand off for further investigation.
missing_evidence: Logs for order/checkout (ev-...-order_logs was excluded) to identify any error signatures
Error-rate or 5xx metrics over a wider window to confirm whether checkout errors actually occurred
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the alert window
Trace samples capturing failing requests, if any exist
